Implementation Plan

## Implementation plan: update `tests/e2e_smoke_canary.txt`

Scope-mode: Hold Scope
Reuse-audit: extends tests/e2e_smoke_canary.txt
Scope-mode justification: The issue fully specifies the change. It is a complete overwrite of one existing fixture file with three exact lines and nothing else. No helper, script, workflow or test needs to change. The issue forbids touching any other file, so no changelog fragment or agents.d fragment is added.

## Files likely to change
- `tests/e2e_smoke_canary.txt`

## Functions or modules to implement
None. This is a data-only edit. Overwrite the file so its bytes are exactly:
```
status: ok
run_id: 38830172694
updated-by: ai-pipeline
```
There is one trailing `\n` after the last line and no other characters: no BOM, no CRLF, no trailing spaces. One equivalent command is `printf 'status: ok\nrun_id: 38830172694\nupdated-by: ai-pipeline\n' > tests/e2e_smoke_canary.txt`.

## Data structures affected
None. Only the plain-text content of the file changes.

## API or interface changes
None.

## Decisions
### D1 — Overwrite the whole file instead of editing it in place
- Chosen: Replace the entire contents with the three specified lines.
- Alternatives considered: Editing only the lines that differ from the current content.
- Why: The issue requires the file to be exactly these three lines. A full overwrite guarantees that no earlier content is left behind.

### D2 — No changelog fragment
- Chosen: Leave `changelog.d/` untouched.
- Alternatives considered: Adding a `changelog.d/<issue>-<slug>.md` fragment.
- Why: The issue says to modify only this file. The change is an E2E smoke canary with no user-visible behaviour.

## Security considerations
- No trust boundary, endpoint, credential or external input is involved.
- The content is static, and the `run_id` value comes from the issue body as given.
- Abuse cases: none. The file is a test fixture that no pipeline code executes.

## Risks and edge cases
- A missing trailing newline, or an extra blank line, would fail the "exactly three lines" requirement.
- CRLF line endings must not be introduced.
- No conflict detected: the issue says the file already exists. The implementer should confirm this, and must not create directories.

## Testing considerations
- Run `cmp <(printf 'status: ok\nrun_id: 38830172694\nupdated-by: ai-pipeline\n') tests/e2e_smoke_canary.txt`; it must exit 0.
- Run `git diff --stat`; it must show only `tests/e2e_smoke_canary.txt`.

## Pre-execution self-check
The plan covers the full requirement, changes only the one allowed file, and needs no external inputs.
